global_id_coverage: Disjoint fetch-add reservations clipped to [0,records); completed totals must equal records; the unchanged bijection maps the same id_base+offset IDs to unique keys.
productive_end: max worker last_end_ns, measured from worker_start; supplementary metric retaining full body/drain wall and CPU.
validation_performed: Dry command preparation; no compiler or workload invocation
validation_pending: C compilation by root under lock
Both modes small fixed-record smoke, ideally non-multiple of1024
limitations: Shared mode changes worker-key assignment and adds one atomic reservation per1024 records.
Both modes use new driver layout; compare them inside this same binary rather than attributing changes against an old driver solely to quota mode.
A final batch can still contain slow database work; shared quotas reduce quota imbalance but do not guarantee zero tail.
